content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"In-home personal care and home health delivery to elderly and disabled clients, not claims or cost containment services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"PEO payroll and HR outsourcing for small businesses, with insurance premiums, rather than claims management for payers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Economic and litigation consulting sold to law firms and companies, not managed care or claims cost containment."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Claims management, adjusting and medical cost management for insurers and self-insured employers, closely matching CorVel's workers' comp services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Telecom network construction and maintenance contracting, unrelated to healthcare claims or managed care services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Franchised insurance brokerage selling personal and commercial policies, not claims processing or medical cost management."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"HSA custody and account administration for employers, with payment cards; it lacks claims cost containment and provider networks."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Consulting and revenue cycle outsourcing for hospitals, universities and companies, not managed care claims services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Building mechanical, electrical and controls installation and maintenance, a construction and facilities trade business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Outpatient mental health clinics delivering care to patients, rather than managing claims for payers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced government program administration such as eligibility and call centers, sold to government agencies."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Physician staffing and professional care delivery to hospitals, a provider service rather than payer-side claims management."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, healthcare and IT staffing supplied on contract, not claims or cost containment services."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning carrier commissions, a distribution business rather than claims cost containment."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Skilled nursing, senior living and post-acute care facilities, which are care providers rather than payer-side services."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Retail independent insurance agency selling policies to individuals and businesses, not claims or medical cost management."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Outpatient physical therapy clinics and occupational health programs that deliver patient care, not claims management for payers."},{"label":"C18","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates acute care and behavioral hospitals, a facility-based care provider rather than a claims services firm."}]}
